primary_change: Replaces generic statistical analytics with construction-specific statistical controls for project control decisions.

control_packages.Full Project Control: Complete control across schedule, workforce, cost, progress payment, material continuity, risks and decisions.
control_packages.Schedule Recovery: Schedule / Delay + Workforce: delay analysis, manpower gap and recovery plan.
control_packages.Cost & Payment Control: Cost Estimate + Progress Payment: EN uses Progress Payment, AZ uses F-2.
control_packages.Material Continuity: Material stock, delivery, procurement continuity and shortage risk.
control_packages.Risk & Decisions: Risk register, decision prompts and recommended management actions.

safe_model: Agents report and prepare decisions; production changes require manual approval.
